newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana names new central bank chief.
newsitem.headline: Ghana names new central bank chief.

text.p: The government of Ghana said on Wednesday that it had appointed Kwabena Duffour as governor of the Central Bank of Ghana, with immediate effect.
Duffour, currently one of the bank's two deputy governors, takes over from Godfried Agama, whose contract was due to expire on July 17.
The government also announced the appointment of Charles Asembiri, currently general manager of the Ghana Stock Exchange, as commissioner of the customs and excise service, CEPS.
"The appointments were made by the President (Jerry Rawlings) in consultation with the council of state and are with immediate effect," the official statement said.
It did not name any replacement for Asembiri at the stock exchange.
